verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents its own desktop app alongside mobile and web, with end-to-end encrypted sync across devices. Desktop-specific features are documented, including QR-image import, right-click editing and Flathub distribution, and a community user reports adopting it after Authy dropped its desktop app. Missing for 10: explicit per-OS desktop platform coverage (Windows/macOS install docs), independent hands-on review of desktop feature parity.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile

citations.quote: Auth has an app for every platform. Mobile, desktop and web. Your codes sync across all your devices, end-to-end encrypted.
Auth is now officially available on [Flathub](https://flathub.org/apps/io.ente.auth)!
Added support for importing 2FA codes from QR code images on desktop.
You can delete or edit a code by long pressing (or right clicking on desktop) on that item.
Ente Auth is awesome - I've been using it ever since Authy discontinued their desktop app.
